
```{r}
#| label: attention-list
#| results: asis
# Median absolute deviation, not SD, for the "unusually noisy" rule: with a
# handful of subjects the very outliers being looked for would inflate an SD
# enough to hide themselves inside it.
notes <- character()

high_rej <- subj %>% filter(pct_rejected > 25)
if (nrow(high_rej) > 0) {
  notes <- c(notes, sprintf("- **More than 25%% of trials rejected**: %s.",
    paste(sprintf("%s (%s%%)", high_rej$dataset, apa_num(high_rej$pct_rejected, 1)), collapse = ", ")))
}

mad_sd <- mad(subj$median_baseline_sd, na.rm = TRUE)
med_sd <- median(subj$median_baseline_sd, na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.na(mad_sd) && mad_sd > 0) {
  noisy <- subj %>% filter(median_baseline_sd > med_sd + 3 * mad_sd)
  if (nrow(noisy) > 0) {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("- **Unusually noisy relative to the rest of the sample** (> 3 MAD above the median): %s.",
      paste(sprintf("%s (%s uV)", noisy$dataset, apa_num(noisy$median_baseline_sd)), collapse = ", ")))
  }
}

# n_trials > 20 as well as kept < 20: a bin that never had 20 trials to
# begin with cannot end up with 20, and saying so every time describes
# the design rather than the data quality. The flag is for trials LOST,
# so it only applies where there were enough to lose.
low_n <- qual %>% distinct(dataset, bin, n_trials, n_trials_rejected) %>%
  mutate(kept = n_trials - n_trials_rejected) %>%
  filter(kept < 20, n_trials > 20)
if (nrow(low_n) > 0) {
  notes <- c(notes, sprintf("- **Fewer than 20 surviving trials in a bin that started with more**: %s.",
    paste(sprintf("%s / %s (%d of %d left)", low_n$dataset, low_n$bin, low_n$kept, low_n$n_trials), collapse = ", ")))
}

truncated <- subj %>% filter(pct_truncated > 0)
if (nrow(truncated) > 0) {
  notes <- c(notes, sprintf(paste0("- **Trials truncated at a recording boundary** (they still ",
    "enter the average, with less data at the ends): %s. Nothing rejected these; the epoch ",
    "ran off the start or end of the file."),
    paste(sprintf("%s (%s%% of trials, worst one missing %s%% of its epoch)", truncated$dataset,
                  apa_num(truncated$pct_truncated, 1), apa_num(truncated$max_truncated_pct, 1)),
          collapse = ", ")))
}

bad_chan <- qual %>% filter(pct_flagged > 20) %>% distinct(dataset, channel)
if (nrow(bad_chan) > 0) {
  notes <- c(notes, sprintf("- **Channel flagged in more than 20%% of trials** (a candidate for interpolation): %s.",
    paste(sprintf("%s / %s", bad_chan$dataset, bad_chan$channel), collapse = ", ")))
}

# The mirror of the line above: a channel that is mostly RECONSTRUCTED rather than
# mostly missing. It needs saying separately because nothing else in the report can
# reveal it -- interpolated samples are real numbers, so they pass every noise and
# rejection check as ordinary data.
interp_chan <- qual %>% filter(pct_interpolated > 20) %>% distinct(dataset, channel)
if (nrow(interp_chan) > 0) {
  notes <- c(notes, sprintf(paste0("- **Channel interpolated in more than 20%% of trials**: %s. ",
                                   "More than a fifth of this channel is an estimate from its ",
                                   "neighbours rather than a measurement. That is a legitimate ",
                                   "repair for one bad electrode, but it should be reported, and ",
                                   "and the artefact should be checked against the ",
                                   "neighbours it was reconstructed from."),
    paste(sprintf("%s / %s", interp_chan$dataset, interp_chan$channel), collapse = ", ")))
}

# A CALLOUT, AND FIRST IN THE SECTION. These lines are the only part of
# this report that names a specific subject or channel to go and look at,
# and they used to be printed as plain text underneath a long table of
# threshold justifications, where a reader scanning the document could
# pass them without noticing. The criteria that produced them are
# reference material and now sit below.
if (length(notes) == 0) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-tip title=\"Nothing flagged\"}\n")
  cat("Nothing crossed any of the conventional thresholds checked here. The thresholds\n")
  cat("themselves are listed below, so that what was looked for is on the record\n")
  cat("alongside the fact that nothing met it.\n")
  cat(":::\n\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("\n::: {.callout-warning title=\"%d item(s) worth a look\"}\n", length(notes)))
  cat(paste(notes, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  cat("\nNothing here has been excluded, and none of these lines is an exclusion\n")
  cat("decision. The threshold behind each one, and the reasoning for it, is given\n")
  cat("below.\n")
  cat(":::\n\n")
}
```
